title: Undefined Cardinality in Billing Instrument Hierarchy
description: Tests discovery of unbounded entity relations where collections ('multiple billing profiles', 'multiple credit cards') lack explicit minimum/maximum cardinality constraints.

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*attach multiple billing profiles.*multiple authorized corporate credit cards.*

expectedFindings.rationale: The relationship between organizations, billing profiles, and credit cards specifies 'multiple' without defining bounds (minimum zero allowed? maximum cap? pagination limits?).
